profile.headline: Software Engineer, Applied AI
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer, Product Builder, AI Engineer
profile.summary:
Software and product developer with over 20 years in application development, database, API, web, cloud, and AI. Agile and full SDLC work. Able to fill PM, PO, QA roles. Strong in writing, customer service, and sales support. Experience includes roles at startups, Fortune 500, and midsize companies undergoing rapid growth. Innovative. Detail-oriented. 

.NET / C# / Python / API's / SQL Server / Git / GitHub / Azure / AWS / GCP / Artificial Intelligence / backend / distributed application development / frontend (HTML5, CSS, MVC, Angular, Vue.js)

AI LLM API’s, frontier model use (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Meta), Jupyter Notebook, LangChain, HuggingFace, Replit. Azure AI: Cognitive Services, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Image and Vision, Prompting.

Agile team member who is dedicated to his work. I build, test and ship functionality and quality code. Bringing necessary and missing pieces together, I see gaps and risks others don't. I understand requirements, pose relevant questions, and grasp a business domain well. I collaborate and innovate. 

With CI/CD DevOps culture experience, I am a reliable engineer / technologist who stands up to bring my best and continuously improve. Alongside a winning team, I deliver products users need. My work history spans n-tier, web, cloud and microservices / distributed architectures aimed at SOLID principles.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Product Builder, AI Engineer
positions.description:
* DocuSign (via PrimeTeam Partners) - .NET and AWS code analysis, documentation, solution recommendation, code refactoring, Salesforce API and Zuora API integration (2020).
* .NET Core 2.2 work for online training product for client. ASP.NET Identity for users, roles, registration; subscription/plan selection; user time tracking; dashboard. C#, ASP.NET MVC / Razor Pages, EF Core work. AWS integration. Braintree SDK work. Testing with xUnit and SQL Server InMemory. Reached milestone for MVP. Clarified requirements and backlog (2019).
* Intuit (via Cydio Group) - TurboTax tax form re-platforming project. Proprietary languages and tools, Eclipse, Jenkins, XML, extensive testing across product versions. Left for eldercare duties (2018).
* Engagement with retail grocery chain. Analyzed, fixed and refactored integration process.  Reduced processing time from over 2 hours to less than 15 minutes to reduce store shrink. Implemented parallel solution using producer-consumer pattern and asynchronous code. Integration with 3rd party API/COM component. Worked with internal DBA, operational and architectural teams (2014).
* Work for higher education assessment software product. Refactor ASP.NET WebForms software used to build and publish forms/surveys and related reporting. ASP.NET, C#, LINQ, REST API’s. JavaScript front-end work with backbone.js, Twitter Bootstrap, underscore.js and jQuery (2013).
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework · Architecture · .NET Core · Front-End Development · HTML5 · Functional Requirements · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · MySQL · Git · Scrum · Cloud Computing · Communication · REST APIs · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer working on various projects including a developer portal (think comparable Spotify's Backstage project), API management and security, and internal colleges website for 3rd party training courses to upskill employees on focused areas. .NET Core 3.1, Azure, Cosmos DB, NoSQL, ASP.NET, Vue, Vuetify, GitHub and GitHub Actions. Note: I performed full stack work and API gateway support/migration. Title, Consulting API Engineer, was not a representative match to full range of duties.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Front-End Development · HTML5 · Functional Requirements · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Apigee API Management · Git · Scrum · Cloud Computing · Communication · Terraform · REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Tech stack: C#, .NET 4.6.1, Web API, SQL Server 2016, Entity Framework, Simple Injector, Automapper, MStest/NUnit, microservices, AWS (SNS, SQS, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB), DevOps (TeamCity, Octopus, git, nuget),  VS2015, ReSharper, SQL Prompt, JavaScript, AngularJS, Hangfire, FluentMigrator, Dapper, Aspose SDK. Agile tools: JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Slack.
* Developer on high-velocity scrum team releasing (2x / month) functionality for significant business growth related to: financing product rules and selection; editing and saving home improvement selections, attributes and amounts; closing loans and related compliance conditions; document generation; esigning (Docusign); consumer protections (data-driven call scripts); contractor lending; pub/sub eventing; and cross-team integration.
* Contribute to architecture and DevOps tooling, work closely with dev managers, product owner/manager, and architecture team. Rep/lead in cross team meetings. Part of DDD / microservice efforts. Onboard and train new employees. Openly share domain expertise and technical experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework · Architecture · .NET Core · Functional Requirements · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Git · Cloud Computing · Node.js · Communication · REST APIs · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
* Mobile and .NET / C# mobile API development for medical parts tracking / logistics solution for manufacturers, distributors and representatives.
* Full experience with cross-platform mobile code (iOS and Android) using Apache Cordova / Phonegap, JavaScript, jQuery Mobile, sqlite, and AJAX. Features implemented include: login, data synchronization, performance improvements, and UI development. Bug fixes on existing code base towards release. Add new business logic and features rapidly in agile environment.
* Assumed responsibility for .NET mobile API (HTTPS web service) in WCF. Stabilized and refactored code base. Features include: data loading and synchronization, token based authentication, facade pattern support, CRUD operations for entities / data layer. Google Maps API integration, queue processing. T-SQL stored procedure and view work on complex data model.
* Tools: Visual Studio 2013, Xcode, JIRA, Confluence, Sublime Text, git.
positions.insights: Skills: Architecture · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Git · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst III
positions.description:
* Project work to refactor single threaded batch processing application for store / retail inventory management / shrink solution into multithreaded, parallel solution. Results would enable large cost savings and operational efficiencies. Literally reduced processing times from hours to minutes.
* Architected and developed solution with enterprise architect, senior DBA and senior IT Manager. 
* Implemented solution using NET Task Parallel Library with producer-consumer pattern.
* Integrated with enterprise queue services (WebSphere Message Broker) and third-party product COM API - Invatron Software.
* Other optimizations: migration of application from DB2 to SQL Server, SQL Server data partitioning, async / await, 64-bit support, parallel processing of ADO.NET record sets.
* Wrote unit tests for large scale data balancing with Visual Studio test. Load testing with SoapUI Pro.
* Scalable solution was completed to support up to 1200 stores for parent company that owns Winn-Dixie, Bi-Lo, Harveys, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Architecture · Functional Requirements · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Communication · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

positions.title: Application Developer Analyst III - .NET / C#
positions.description:
Senior .NET developer role, engaged in full stack application development on highly distributed and complex product for financial claims processing for major mortgage lenders and investors. 
.NET 4.5, asynchronous processing, WCF, ASP.NET, Javascript, JSON, Knockout, jQuery, T4 template code generation, SQL Server 2012, Visual Studio 2012, ARR, TFS, continuous integration 
Member of a highly visible 15+ person team employing Agile development processes. Work in all tiers of application with many integration points. Coordinate implementation of application security features, including Whitehat scan, Veracode scan, and web layer ID obfuscation. Began work as a contractor through Interactive Resources, LLC
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · HTML5 · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Scrum · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

company.name: Lender Procesing Services (now Black Knight Financial Services)

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Development work for higher education software company. .NET backend, integration and architecture work for Assessment product. Rewrite and refactor software used to build and publish forms/surveys for data collection and reporting by universities (full stack project). ASP.NET, C# and LINQ development work. REST web services API development. Javascript front-end work with backbone.js, Twitter Boostrap, underscore.js and jQuery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
US Department of Energy Loan Guarantee Program. Work on all tiers of application on 10-15 person team for loan and portfolio management project for US Department of Energy. Maintenance and new development, including business layer code, architecture patterns, site-wide search functionality, complex data entry forms and custom controls. Refactored data access layer and use of Entity Framework for improved performance, efficiency, and improved code maintenance. Primary technologies used: NET 4.0, LINQ, Entity Framework, SQL Server 2008 R2, Telerik RAD controls.

FINS (Fisheries Information Network System) project assignment for the Missouri Department of Conservation. Completed a project for 1.0 production release. Development work as a Senior Software Engineer on web-based data management application for biologists to track fish population information (age, growth, etc.) in Missouri state waterbodies. Finished tasks within complex pre-existing codebase base (heavy OO design and design pattern usage) on a tight deadline. Work was done using: C#, SQL Server 2008 R2, jQuery, css, ASP.NET custom user controls, NHibernate, Subversion, design patterns (primarily MVVM). Assisted Project Manager / Business Analyst in task definition, test cases, communication and meetings with customers, and requirements clarification. Assisted other developers on project to complete deliverables and to integrate project work.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework · Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Scrum · Communication

positions.title: IT Developer and Project Manager
positions.description: Development and IT work for a well-established home and residential property services company. Worked with company's managing partners' to develop custom financial dashboard reporting application using PHP, MySQL and ZingChart on Ubuntu 11.04. Automated daily reporting paper forms to capture sales, expense and job information to feed into dashboard. Upgraded, developed and managed company web sites in WordPress, including plug-ins, theme and PHP customization. SQL Server database reporting and integration project work with ServiceCEO field service application. Hired and managed 2 contractors for short-term custom development projects. Oversaw SEO, Internet marketing and Internet sales lead tracking efforts. Ongoing Python, Django, jQuery, Mercurial / DVCS project work.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Part of product design and engineering  department for high-traffic, well-known consumer health media site. Worked on Community software development (social networking features), such as message boards and a custom Facebook-style activity stream; WCF and XML over HTTP web services work; integration and migration projects;  Hearst Digital Media SSO API implementation for 18 web site network; code refactoring; and a number of web site performance and specialized tasks, such as  implementing content caching, encryption code for security, and resolving third-party URL rewriter memory leak behavior with Microsoft. Continued with .NET development in C#, VB.NET, Visual Studio 2008, JavaScript and AJAX, and also worked with Eclipse, PHP and PHPBB development and legacy code in Visual C++ and ASP. Agile development practices with Rally, iteration cycles, and daily stand-up meetings. Worked with contractors to successfully transfer their project in-house. Real Age Assessment Platform (RAAP) work as a contractor (2/2010 - 4/2010).
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Scrum · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

positions.title: Web Application Engineer / Database Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Worked to successfully complete a variety of software and database projects for company's major insurance/financial services clients.  Implemented .NET web and portal solutions and modules for real-time quoting, compensation, certificate and claim inquiry.  Developed new web based products.  Worked in C# / .NET n-tier applications using ASP.NET WebForms, AJAX, NHibernate, and netTiers ORM. Extensive database and SQL work. Designed and implemented an innovative .NET API solution to communicate with company's core IBM mainframe COBOL/CICS based software. Implemented custom solutions for claim processing, producer information, and business process automation for a global call center. Supported company's SQL Server based data warehouse product and related DTS packages; wrote custom aggregates and ETL processes that drove web-based search functionality. Helped define .NET software development processes. Administered and customized Clientele CRM application. Worked closely with various staff members and contractors.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: As a contractor for a leading outsourced telecommunications billing provider, I analyzed, designed and implemented an ETL solution to support over 25 phone company vendor billing data formats using  SQL Server and DTS. Reverse engineered data formats and converted legacy Access, Excel and VB applications. Solution was integrated into customer's operational processes and distributed .NET software architecture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Manager
positions.description: Software Engineering - Web applications development for educational software development company. Oversaw development and database operations for Auto eDirect CRM application used by auto dealers and BonusPoints  (point redemption system) and TechBuilder (online planning tool) products sponsored by Compaq/HP.  Wrote internal time/project tracking system. Redesigned applications for Section 508 compliance. Worked in ColdFusion, HTML, JavaScript, Visual Basic and SQL Server. While a manager, lead up to 5 developers and helped define development standards. Participated in re-architecture of products to .NET/C#.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Promoted to software engineer in world class engineering department with award winning telecommunications products. Worked on element management system (EMS) and billing/call detail record (CDR) applications. Utilized ASP, Visual Basic, SQL and Java/J2EE. Wrote detailed design documents. Familiar with Voice over IP technologies. Worked with India based off shore development team.; Developed custom IT applications for company. Integration with ERP, HR and financial applications. Designed and wrote web based product configurator, timecard system, helpdesk application, open enrollment for benefits, sales and marketing reporting, and financial tracking applications. Used ColdFusion, SQL Server, Informix 4GL, and ASP. Some mentoring and supervision of other developers.

positions.title: Instructor (part-time / evenings)
positions.description: Taught classes “Web Servers” and “Connecting Your Database to the Web”.
